sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate is semantically faithful and deterministic validation is valid. It targets ship-owned properties, uses the compatible hull-area controlled values, applies the other-ice-strengthened-area alternative with the required direct quantities and fixed inclusive AR=3.6, preserves the MPa/metre/degree/unitless units, and correctly enforces bow applicability as gamma > 0 and gamma < 80 with beta > 10.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the hull-area alternative constraint: assignedHullArea has canonical range nltl:hullAreaValue, so do not include nltl:otherIceStrengthenedAreaValue, whose canonical range is nltl:hullRegionValue; retain only controlled values compatible with hullAreaValue. Also encode the requirement's independence boundary for Pavg, bNonBow, and wNonBow rather than merely requiring their presence, without inventing a new term or formula. The fixed AR=3.6 bounds, MPa/metre/degree/unitless units, ship targeting, and applicability comparison direction are otherwise aligned.

Do not make averageIcePressure, nonBowLoadPatchHeight, and nonBowLoadPatchLength unconditionally mandatory for every ship. Encode the requirement's applicability to otherIceStrengthenedArea, and preserve the independence boundary by validating these as direct ship-owned quantities without any hull-shape or component dependency; presence-only constraints are insufficient. Retain the fixed inclusive AR=3.6 bounds, declared units, hull-area range-compatible controlled values, and the existing gamma/beta comparison direction.

The candidate is semantically faithful and deterministic validation is valid. It targets ship-owned properties, uses the compatible hull-area controlled values, applies the other-ice-strengthened-area alternative with the required direct quantities and fixed inclusive AR=3.6, preserves the MPa/metre/degree/unitless units, and correctly enforces bow applicability as gamma > 0 and gamma < 80 with beta > 10.
